newsitem.title: USA: Cooperative Computing extends Triad offer.
newsitem.headline: Cooperative Computing extends Triad offer.

text.p: Cooperative Computing Inc said its affiliate, CCI Acquisition Corp, again extended its tender offer for all of the issued and outstanding shares of common stock of Triad Systems Corp.
The offer was extended to Jan 17. The offer price of $9.25 per share in cash was scheduled to expire today.
CCI Acquisition said that as of Dec 31, 12.0 million shares of Triad Systems common stock, or about 67.6 percent of the issued and outstanding shares, were validly tendered and not withdrawn.
The Federal Trade Commission is continuing its review of the tender offer and Cooperative Computing, CCI Acquisition and Triad are cooperating with the review, the company said.
